context_requirements: Expression of coagulation factor X (F10) or other vitamin K-dependent coagulation factors
An intact coagulation cascade or thrombin-generation capacity
Presence of thrombin/PAR-mediated signaling that can be modulated by upstream factor inhibition
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of coagulation, thrombin signaling, or PAR-mediated gene signatures after treatment
Consistent transcriptional responses across multiple cell lines despite the absence of a functional coagulation cascade

evidence.supports: Antithrombin III, a coagulation factor inhibitor, reduced inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in a rat acute kidney injury model, but this is an in vivo injury context and does not establish direct transcriptional effects in the nine human cell lines.
